sql: SELECT c.remote_jid, c.contact_name, c.bot_step, c.bot_enabled, m.from_me, to_char(m.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI:SS') AS hora, m.message_type, left(m.content, 120) AS texto, encode(convert_to(left(m.content, 12), 'UTF8'), 'hex') AS hex, m.metadata->>'source' AS origem, w.provider FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id JOIN wapi_instances w ON w.id = c.instance_id JOIN companies co ON co.id = w.company_id WHERE co.name ILIKE '%mega%magic%' AND ((c.remote_jid LIKE '5511947594084%' AND m.timestamp >= '2026-10-19T19:00:00Z' AND m.timestamp < '2026-10-19T20:00:00Z') OR (c.remote_jid LIKE '55119964723%' AND m.timestamp >= '2026-10-19T15:40:00Z' AND m.timestamp < '2026-10-19T16:30:00Z')) ORDER BY c.remote_jid, m.timestamp
